item.title: Jenkins Needs Java 21, Your Old Build Hosts Stop at Java 8: I Built Agent8
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: Jenkins agents must run Java 21 too, so build hosts that stop at Java 8, such as Solaris, HP-UX and AIX 7.1, can no longer join a current Jenkins. Agent8 downgrades the official agent.jar to Java 8 so they keep working as ordinary agents.

item.title: Keelhaven Releases New Version—This Time, Updates Come from Real User Feedback
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: Most updates in Keelhaven 0.8.0 come from real user feedback: new backup destinations, customizable backup parameters, backup preview, and only keeping the latest N snapshots.

item.title: Keelhaven: A Mac Menu Bar App for restic Backups
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: Keelhaven is a macOS menu bar app for restic: pick folders, a destination and a schedule, then forget about it. Backups go to your own drive, S3 bucket or NAS and are encrypted on your Mac first. There is no account, and no data collection of any kind.

item.title: Python Supply Chain 'Nuclear Bomb' Attack Just Happened—A `pip install` Steals All Your Credentials!
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: A Python supply chain attack has occurred, where a single pip install can steal all your credentials. This post introduces how to use pipguard to intercept malicious packages before installation.

item.title: py-eol 1.0: Catch End-of-Life Python Versions in CI
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: py-eol checks whether the Python versions your project uses have reached end of life. It scans project files and reports each EOL version with its file and line number, warns ahead of time with –warn-before, and runs in CI as a GitHub Action or a pre-commit hook so expired versions cannot slip back in.

item.title: py-eol — You Might Be Using 'Expired Python' Without Realizing It
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: py-eol is a lightweight tool that helps you quickly determine if a Python version is expired or approaching EOL. It’s suitable for local use and can also be integrated into CI/CD for more reliable version management in projects.
